name: Spare Stay
summary: Short stays where hosts keep everything except the at-cost fee, guests see the full price from the first search, and hosts own the app and vote on its rules. It runs on the kit's shared marketplace loop and named kit parts, and adds only what stays need.

areas.name: Accounts and profiles
areas.summary: One Spareware login for guests, hosts, co-hosts, cleaners and property managers, with Stay's own profile fields, business details and the checks each role needs, on the kit's accounts and identity checks.

features.name: Sign up and sign in
features.does: Create a Spare Stay account with a passkey, email or phone, and sign in on any device.

parts.name: Stay sign-in set-up
parts.what: Uses the kit's passkey-first sign-in screens, asking only what a booking needs: a name, an email and a phone number.

parts.name: Stay roles
parts.what: Stay's roles (guest, host, co-host, cleaner and property manager) on the kit's roles per app, each with its own permissions.

parts.name: Recovery rules for payout holders
parts.what: Stay asks for the kit's extra recovery checks for hosts and anyone else who receives payouts, and holds payouts for a waiting period after a recovery.

parts.name: Minimum ages
parts.what: Only adults (18 and over) can book or host, set on the kit's minimum age at sign-up and confirmed from the identity check's date of birth when a check is needed.

features.name: Profiles
features.does: Show who you are with a name, photo, languages, a short bio and verified badges.

parts.name: Profile page
parts.what: A public profile with name, photo, languages, bio, member since and verified checks.

parts.name: Profile fields and visibility
parts.what: What each profile field holds and who can see it before and after a booking.

parts.name: Profile photo checks
parts.what: Photos are checked for banned content before they show; any face check runs under the Biometric Processing Privacy Code 2025 through the kit, with a person reviewing a failed match.

features.name: Identity checks
features.does: Check your ID once, through a regulated provider, so hosts and guests can trust each other.

parts.name: Stay's ID checks
parts.what: Guests and hosts check their ID once through the kit's identity check; Stay keeps only the result, and any selfie match runs under the Biometric Processing Privacy Code 2025 with a non-biometric option.

parts.name: Overseas guests' IDs
parts.what: Stay's needs for the kit's identity provider choice: passports and licences from the countries NZ's visitors come from, and what each check costs.

parts.name: When a check is needed
parts.what: Stay's rules on the kit's check rules per app for when an ID check is required: every host, and guests for instant booking or high-risk stays.

features.name: Host business details
features.does: Record whether you host as a private person or a business, with the tax details income reporting needs, kept private, and show guests which one you are.

parts.name: Host business record
parts.what: Private person or business, legal name, IRD number, date of birth for individuals, GST registration and NZBN, on the kit's seller details and held privately.

parts.name: Business details screens
parts.what: Screens to enter and update tax and business details.

parts.name: Private or business host
parts.what: Shows guests on the listing and the receipt whether the host is a private person or a business, with the business's trader details, since consumer law rights differ.

features.name: Account security
features.does: Keep your account safe, with a second sign-in step required for anyone who receives payouts or sees guests' addresses.

parts.name: Second step for hosts
parts.what: Hosts, co-hosts and anyone else who receives payouts or sees guests' addresses must turn on the kit's second sign-in step; devices, sign-in alerts and payout change holds come from the kit.

features.name: Travel companions
features.does: Add the people you travel with so they see the trip details and can message the host.

parts.name: Trip companions
parts.what: Invite co-travellers to a booking so they see the trip page and the chat. People on an order should move down into the kit, since Food, Ride and Work need the same.

parts.name: Companion screens
parts.what: Invite, list and remove travel companions.

features.name: Host and cleaner courses
features.does: Take short courses with certificates: host basics, and an orientation for cleaners.

parts.name: Stay courses
parts.what: Short courses on the kit's training module: host basics (legal duties, safety and fair treatment) and cleaner orientation, each with a certificate shown on the profile.

areas.name: Listings
areas.summary: Hosts describe a place truthfully and fully: what it is, where it is, what it has, its rules, its accessibility and safety, and its photos, checked before it goes live.

features.name: Create a listing
features.does: Follow step-by-step setup to list a whole home, a room, a bach, a cabin, a campsite or a small hotel's rooms.

parts.name: Listing data model
parts.what: Stay's listing fields on the kit's listing model and the shared property record: place type, rooms, beds, bathrooms, guest limit, address and everything else a listing holds, changed only by operations.

parts.name: Listing setup steps
parts.what: Step-by-step setup that saves as you go and can be finished later.

parts.name: Place types
parts.what: The list of place types and what each must state, from whole homes and rooms to hotel rooms and campsites; a campsite or glamping site needs a council certificate of registration before it can go live.

parts.name: Draft, publish and snooze
parts.what: Listings stay drafts until checks pass, then go live; hosts can snooze or unlist them, and unlisting with bookings still to come follows the rule for future bookings.

parts.name: Getting there and signal
parts.what: Facts for remote places: mobile coverage by network, the nearest spot with signal, gravel or four-wheel-drive roads, and boat, ferry or tidal access, shown before booking and kept in the offline trip.

features.name: Photos
features.does: Add photos with captions and sort them room by room.

parts.name: Photo screens
parts.what: Upload, reorder, caption and tag photos by room, on the kit's file uploads, with image descriptions for screen readers from the kit.

parts.name: Photo checks
parts.what: Stay's use of the kit's photo privacy check, adding house numbers and street signs to what it flags; copied photos are reported through the kit's copyright notices.

features.name: Description, amenities and house rules
features.does: Describe the place, tick its amenities, and set house rules such as pets, smoking, parties, quiet hours and check-in times.

parts.name: Amenity list
parts.what: A standard amenity list with exact meanings, so filters work the same in every language.

parts.name: House rules
parts.what: Standard and custom house rules that guests accept before booking, including any body corporate rules on noise, security and common areas.

parts.name: Description editor
parts.what: Title, description and space details, with plain-language tips.

parts.name: Writing help
parts.what: Optional AI help to draft a description from the host's own notes and photos, on the kit's co-op AI, marked as AI and always edited by the host.

features.name: Location and privacy
features.does: Set the exact address for booked guests and show only an approximate area to everyone else.

parts.name: Address and pin
parts.what: Finds the address with the kit's address search and lets the host move the pin.

parts.name: Approximate location
parts.what: Stay's use of the kit's approximate location: the offset is set once per listing and never changes, so repeated searches can't average it out.

parts.name: Address check
parts.what: Confirms the host controls the address, to stop fake listings.

features.name: Accessibility details
features.does: Describe step-free access, door widths, bathroom features and more, with a photo proving each one.

parts.name: Accessibility features list
parts.what: Measurable features such as step-free entry, door width in centimetres and grab rails.

parts.name: Feature photos and review
parts.what: Each feature needs its own photo and is reviewed before it shows.

parts.name: What disabled travellers need listed
parts.what: Research with disabled travellers and NZ disability groups on which details matter, with sources.

features.name: Safety details
features.does: Declare smoke alarms, carbon monoxide alarms, first aid, pools, hazards and any cameras or noise monitors.

parts.name: Safety declarations
parts.what: Required safety facts for each place type, shown to guests before they book.

parts.name: Cameras and monitors rule
parts.what: Outdoor cameras and noise monitors must be disclosed; cameras inside are banned.

parts.name: NZ safety facts
parts.what: NZ facts for each place: the water source (town supply, tank or bore) and whether a shared supply is registered with Taumata Arowai; pool and spa barriers under the Building Act; an evacuation scheme where a building houses more than 5 people (unless 3 or fewer household units); and smoke alarm checks. Each legal point is marked to verify.

features.name: Listing quality check
features.does: Get a checklist of what is missing or unclear, and pass a review before the listing goes live.

parts.name: Completeness checklist
parts.what: Shows what is missing or unclear, using rules anyone can read.

parts.name: Listing review
parts.what: Stay's checks on the kit's listing checks: new and changed listings are checked automatically, people review flagged ones, and the automatic checks are on the AI use register.

features.name: Many units and room types
features.does: List a set of identical rooms or units once, with how many are free each night.

parts.name: Room and unit types
parts.what: Stay's unit types on the kit's availability calendars: one listing with many identical units and a count free each night.

parts.name: Unit screens
parts.what: Add units, set counts and link each to its own calendar.

features.name: Translated listings
features.does: Show your listing in the guest's language, with your own words kept as the original.

parts.name: Listing translation
parts.what: Stay's use of the kit's machine translation at cost for listing text, marked as translated, with the original one tap away.

parts.name: Host's own translations
parts.what: Hosts write or correct the text in other languages.

features.name: Move from another site
features.does: Bring your own photos, words and calendar link across from another booking site in a few steps.

parts.name: Move-in helper
parts.what: Stay's use of the kit's bulk import: hosts bring their own photos, words and calendar links from another booking site in one flow, checked before anything goes live.

parts.name: What can be brought across
parts.what: Stay's cases for the kit's import terms: hosts bring their own photos, words and calendar links, never other sites' data or reviews.

features.name: Floor plans
features.does: Add a simple floor plan, drawn by hand or brought in from a building model.

parts.name: Floor plans
parts.what: A simple floor plan drawn on the 2D drawing engine, or brought in from a Spare Construct model file through the kit. The plan drawer and the import should move down into the kit or an engine, since Spare Home and Spare Rent map the same; Stay never links to another program directly.

areas.name: Calendar and channel sync
areas.summary: One calendar per place that knows every booking and block, stays in sync with other booking sites, and stops double bookings.

features.name: Host calendar
features.does: See and change availability, prices and bookings for every night on one calendar, and mark nights kept for your own use.

parts.name: Availability data
parts.what: Stay's nights on the kit's availability calendars: each night open, blocked, booked, on hold or kept for the owner's own use, with full history.

parts.name: Calendar view
parts.what: Month and many-listing views with tap to block, tap to price and booking details.

parts.name: Date holds
parts.what: How long Stay holds dates while a guest pays or a request waits, on the kit's availability calendars, so two guests can't take the same nights.

parts.name: Owner use blocks
parts.what: The host marks blocked nights as the owner's own use, so the yearly summary can count private, rented and unused days.

features.name: Stay rules
features.does: Set minimum and maximum stays, arrival days, advance notice, how far ahead guests can book and days between stays, and change them by season.

parts.name: Stay rule set
parts.what: Minimum and maximum nights, allowed arrival and departure days, advance notice, booking window and preparation days.

parts.name: Bookable dates engine
parts.what: Works out which dates a guest can book from Stay's rules and the kit's availability calendars.

parts.name: Seasonal stay rules
parts.what: Stay rules by date range or season, such as a seven-night minimum and Saturday arrivals over Christmas and New Year, with exceptions that let short gaps between bookings be filled.

features.name: Sync with other booking sites
features.does: Import and export calendars with other booking sites, so nights booked there close here.

parts.name: Stay calendar export
parts.what: Stay's export on the kit's calendar import and export: each listing's private link holds booked and blocked nights only, never guest details.

parts.name: Stay calendar import
parts.what: Stay's import on the kit's calendar import and export: imported events block nights, and each linked calendar is refreshed on a published schedule.

parts.name: Double-booking guard
parts.what: Spots overlaps between imported and local bookings with the kit's calendar checks and alerts the host at once.

parts.name: Sync status
parts.what: Shows when each linked calendar last synced and any errors.

parts.name: Double booking resolution
parts.what: When calendar lag causes a double booking, the booking made first stands, by the times both sites record. If that is the other site's, the Spare Stay guest gets a full refund and rebooking help, the host is not penalised when the other site's calendar was late, and both guests are told plainly what happened.

features.name: Channel managers
features.does: Connect a channel manager that updates your rates and availability across sites, if you run many places.

parts.name: Channel connection API
parts.what: Stay's commands for availability, rates and bookings, published for channel managers to use with scoped tokens.

parts.name: Channel manager research
parts.what: Which channel managers NZ hosts use, what open interfaces they offer and what joining costs.

parts.name: Partner sandbox
parts.what: A test area and checklist for channel managers to connect.

parts.name: Property management system links
parts.what: Links to the property management systems NZ motels and small hotels use, through their published interfaces or the channel API, starting with the ones the research shows matter most.

features.name: Personal calendar feed
features.does: Add your trips or bookings to your own calendar app.

parts.name: Calendar feed for people
parts.what: Guests and hosts subscribe to their trips or bookings in any calendar app. Personal calendar feeds should move down into the kit, since Ride, Food and Work bookings need the same.

areas.name: Pricing and the full price
areas.summary: Hosts set prices with clear rules; guests see one full price, with every fee, tax and levy, from the first search.

features.name: Nightly prices
features.does: Set a base nightly price, weekend prices, and prices for seasons and events.

parts.name: Price rules
parts.what: Stay's base, weekend, seasonal and date-specific nightly prices as ordered rules on the kit's pricing rules engine.

parts.name: Price settings
parts.what: Screens for the base price, weekend price, seasons and changing many dates at once.

features.name: Discounts
features.does: Offer weekly and monthly discounts, early-booking and last-minute deals, and a discount for first guests.

parts.name: Discount rules
parts.what: Length-of-stay, early, late and first-guest discounts, applied in a published order on top of Stay's full price.

parts.name: Promotion codes
parts.what: Hosts make codes for returning guests or groups on the kit's promotions and vouchers, always paid by the host who made them, with limits and end dates.

features.name: Price options
features.does: Offer a cheaper price that can't be refunded alongside the flexible price, and let guests choose.

parts.name: Price options
parts.what: More than one price for the same nights, each tied to a cancellation policy.

parts.name: Price option screens
parts.what: Set up options and show guests the difference side by side.

features.name: Extra fees and extras
features.does: Add cleaning, extra guest and pet fees, and optional extras such as firewood or linen hire, all shown in the full price.

parts.name: Fee rules
parts.what: Cleaning, extra guest, pet, linen and other fees, each per stay, per night or per guest.

parts.name: Optional extras
parts.what: Extras guests can add, such as firewood, linen hire or early check-in.

parts.name: Food and alcohol extras
parts.what: Rules for extras that are food or drink. Meals and breakfast hampers must meet the Food Act 2014: small places serving few guests may be exempt from registration (to confirm), but the food must still be safe and suitable. Alcohol can't be sold as an extra without a licence.

features.name: Full price first
features.does: See the total for your dates and guests, with every fee, tax and levy, in every search result.

parts.name: Price engine
parts.what: Stay's full price on the kit's full price first: the total for any dates and guests from nightly rates, fees, the at-cost fee, GST and local levies. Discounts and rate plans plug in once they exist.

parts.name: Price index for search
parts.what: Full prices worked out ahead for common date ranges, so search stays fast.

parts.name: Price breakdown
parts.what: A line-by-line breakdown anyone can open: nights, fees, the at-cost fee, tax and levies.

parts.name: Price display rules
parts.what: Stay's cases for the kit's consumer law duties on showing the total price, in NZ, Australia, the EU and other markets.

features.name: Pricing help
features.does: Get price suggestions from open local data, with the reasons shown.

parts.name: Price suggestions
parts.what: Suggests prices from public and aggregated local data on demand, seasons and events, never from competing hosts' private rates, and shows why.

parts.name: Pricing method research
parts.what: Proven open methods for price suggestions and which data we may legally use.

parts.name: Automatic pricing
parts.what: Optional rules that apply suggestions within limits the host sets.

parts.name: Pricing tools and competition law
parts.what: Price suggestions and automatic pricing use only public or aggregated data, never the pooled private rates of hosts who compete with each other, so the shared tool can't become a cartel provision under the Commerce Act; checked with a lawyer.

features.name: Currencies
features.does: See prices in your own currency while the host is paid in theirs.

parts.name: Currency display
parts.what: Shows prices in the guest's currency on the kit's currencies, at a published rate, and says which rate was used.

parts.name: Currency at payment
parts.what: The guest is charged the full price shown in their currency if they pay within a set time of searching, and is shown the new total first if the rate has moved. Refunds go back in the guest's currency, and who carries an exchange loss on a refund is published.

features.name: Rate plans for hotels, motels and B&Bs
features.does: Offer rate plans such as breakfast included, price by the number of guests and child ages, and cots or high chairs on request.

parts.name: Rate plans
parts.what: Rate plans with meal options such as breakfast included, prices by the number of guests, and child prices by age band, on the price rules.

parts.name: Cots and high chairs on request
parts.what: Guests ask for a cot, a high chair or other items with the booking, and the host confirms.

areas.name: Search and discovery
areas.summary: Guests find the right place by where, when and who, on a map or a list, ranked by rules that are published, with no paid placement.

features.name: Search by place and dates
features.does: Search by town, region, address or landmark, with dates and the number of guests.

parts.name: Search bar
parts.what: Place, dates and guests, with suggestions as you type from the kit's address search, ignoring missing macrons.

parts.name: Stay search fields
parts.what: Stay's fields in the kit's search service: open dates, stay rules and full prices, kept fresh as calendars change, with macron-aware place names.

features.name: Map search
features.does: Browse places on a map with full prices on the pins, and search again as you move it.

parts.name: Map results
parts.what: A map with price pins and clusters that refreshes as you pan.

features.name: Filters
features.does: Filter by price, place type, rooms, beds, amenities, accessibility features, pets, instant booking and more.

parts.name: Filter set
parts.what: Filters built from listing data, with exact meanings in every language.

parts.name: Filter panel
parts.what: A filter panel that shows how many places match before you apply it.

features.name: Flexible dates
features.does: Search for a weekend, a week or a month without fixed dates.

parts.name: Flexible date search
parts.what: Finds open stays of a set length within a month or season.

parts.name: Flexible date picker
parts.what: Pick a weekend, week or month and the months you could go.

features.name: Honest ranking
features.does: See results in an order set by published rules, with no paid placement and the rules one tap away.

parts.name: Stay ranking factors
parts.what: Stay's factors on the kit's published ranking rules: fit to your search, full price, reviews and reliability, with a fair start for new hosts; nobody can pay to rank.

parts.name: Sort choices
parts.what: Sort by full price, distance, rating or newest.

features.name: Wishlists and sharing
features.does: Save places to lists, share a list with your group and pick favourites together.

parts.name: Wishlists
parts.what: Stay's lists on the kit's favourites: named lists of saved places, private or shared by link with a group.

parts.name: Group picks
parts.what: People on a shared list add notes and vote for their favourite.

features.name: Saved searches and alerts
features.does: Save a search and get told when a matching place opens up or the price drops.

parts.name: Saved searches
parts.what: Stay's saved searches on the kit's saved searches: place, dates and guests, with alerts for new matches and lower prices.

parts.name: Alert choices
parts.what: Choose how often alerts come and how they arrive.

features.name: Browse by theme
features.does: Browse ideas such as beach baches, ski towns, pet-friendly or accessible stays.

parts.name: Themes
parts.what: Collections built from open rules on listing data, never paid placement.

parts.name: Theme pages
parts.what: Browse pages for themes and regions.

features.name: Recently viewed and compare
features.does: Go back to places you looked at and compare a few side by side.

parts.name: Recently viewed
parts.what: A private list of places you looked at, kept on your device unless you choose to sync it.

parts.name: Compare places
parts.what: Full price, rooms, rules, reviews and distance side by side.

features.name: Ask in everyday words
features.does: Search in everyday words and compare places side by side with AI help, marked as AI.

parts.name: Everyday-words search
parts.what: Turns a request such as 'a quiet bach near Raglan for four with a dog' into search filters through Stay's MCP commands, marked as AI, with the filters shown so the person can change them.

parts.name: AI comparison
parts.what: An AI summary comparing chosen places side by side, marked as AI and linked to the listing facts it used.

areas.name: Booking
areas.summary: Guests book instantly or by request, see exactly what they agree to, and get a clear confirmation and trip page.

features.name: Listing page
features.does: See photos, the full price, rules, accessibility and safety details, the area, reviews and the host before you book.

parts.name: Listing page
parts.what: The full listing page with photos, full price, rules, details, reviews, map, host profile and whether the host is a private person or a business.

parts.name: Date picker with prices
parts.what: A calendar that shows bookable nights and the total for the dates you pick.

features.name: Instant booking
features.does: Book straight away when the host has turned instant booking on.

parts.name: Booking steps
parts.what: Pick dates and guests, accept the house rules and cancellation policy, pay and confirm.

parts.name: Booking record
parts.what: Stay's booking on the kit's order steps, keeping the price, cancellation policy, house rule and terms versions it was made under.

parts.name: Instant booking conditions
parts.what: Host choices, such as needing an ID check or good reviews before a guest can book instantly.

features.name: Booking requests
features.does: Send a request with a message; the host accepts or declines within 24 hours.

parts.name: Request and reply
parts.what: Requests hold the dates until a reply deadline, then expire on their own.

parts.name: Request screens
parts.what: The guest's request form and the host's accept, decline or ask-a-question screens.

parts.name: Pre-approval and special offers
parts.what: The host pre-approves an inquiry or offers a custom price.

features.name: Guests, children and pets
features.does: Say how many adults, children, infants and pets are coming, and bring a service animal.

parts.name: Guest details
parts.what: Adults, children, infants, pets and service animals, checked against the listing's limits.

parts.name: Service animal rule
parts.what: Stay's use of the kit's assistance animal rule: assistance dogs are always allowed and never charged a pet fee.

features.name: Confirmation and trip page
features.does: Get a confirmation with the booking number, address, check-in time and receipt, and one page for the whole trip.

parts.name: Confirmation
parts.what: Confirmation screen, email and receipt with everything agreed, using the kit's receipts.

parts.name: Trip page
parts.what: One page per trip with dates, address, host, chat, documents, directions and the safety and help buttons.

features.name: Booking documents
features.does: Download a receipt, a GST tax invoice, and a booking letter for visas or employers.

parts.name: Stay tax invoices
parts.what: Stay's content on the kit's tax invoices: whose name and GST number appear follows the seller of record decision, delivered as accessible PDFs.

parts.name: Booking letter
parts.what: A plain letter confirming the stay, for visas or employers.

features.name: Book for someone else
features.does: Book a stay for another person, such as a parent or a colleague.

parts.name: Named main guest
parts.what: The booker and the main guest can differ, with the main guest's contact shared with the host.

features.name: Split the cost
features.does: Split the payment between the people in your group.

parts.name: Split payments
parts.what: Each traveller pays their share before a deadline, or the booker covers the rest, on the kit's split payments.

parts.name: Split screens
parts.what: Invite people, see who has paid and send reminders.

features.name: Business travel
features.does: Book for work, put a company's details on invoices and see a team's trips together.

parts.name: Business accounts
parts.what: Company travellers, a billing contact and company tax details on the kit's organisation model, paying on account through the kit.

parts.name: Travel rules
parts.what: Simple company rules such as a nightly price limit, applied at booking.

features.name: Book several rooms or places at once
features.does: Book several rooms or places for a group, a wedding or a team in one booking.

parts.name: Group bookings
parts.what: One booking that holds several rooms, units or places on the same dates, priced and paid together, so a group doesn't lose dates booking piece by piece.

features.name: Stays paid by someone else
features.does: Have an insurer, civil defence or an agency pay for a stay, including emergency housing after a flood or fire.

parts.name: Third-party payers
parts.what: An insurer, civil defence or a government agency pays for a guest's stay on account, with its own invoices.

parts.name: Emergency housing offers
parts.what: Hosts offer places to people displaced by floods or fires, which agencies can find and book during a declared emergency.

features.name: Pre-arrival questions
features.does: Answer a host's few allowed questions before arrival, such as arrival time, a car registration for parking and access needs.

parts.name: Pre-arrival questions
parts.what: A short, fixed set of questions a host may ask, such as arrival time, a car registration for parking and access needs, each answer kept only until the stay ends.

areas.name: Payments, holds and payouts
areas.summary: Guests pay through a regulated provider, money is held within the provider's time limits, hosts are paid quickly, and the at-cost fee is shown on every booking.

features.name: Pay for a booking
features.does: Pay by card, bank payment or phone wallet through a regulated payment provider.

parts.name: Stay checkout step
parts.what: Stay's step on the kit's checkout: the booking summary, full price, cancellation policy and payment schedule, with card numbers handled only by the provider.

parts.name: Payment methods
parts.what: Stay's needs for the kit's payment provider choice: which cards, bank payments and wallets visitors to NZ use, and what each costs.

parts.name: Payment records
parts.what: Each payment is an operation linked to its booking.

parts.name: Who sells the stay
parts.what: Stay's case for the kit's seller of record decision: whether the host or the co-op supplies the stay, whose name and GST number go on the tax invoice, who owes consumer guarantees and who answers card disputes, for bookings through Spare Stay, hosts' own pages and booking boxes. For GST the co-op is the deemed supplier of listed services.

features.name: Pay in parts
features.does: Pay a deposit when you book and the rest closer to the stay, inside the payment provider's time limits.

parts.name: Payment schedule
parts.what: Stay's schedule on the kit's hold time limits and stage payments: a deposit at booking and the balance charged inside the provider's hold window, with reminders.

parts.name: Payment plan screens
parts.what: Shows what is paid, what is due and when.

features.name: Money held until the stay
features.does: Know your money sits with the payment provider, within its time limits, until check-in, then goes to the host.

parts.name: Stay release point
parts.what: Stay's release point on the kit's hold and release rules: the host's share is released a set time after check-in.

parts.name: Bookings made months ahead
parts.what: The rule for stays booked further ahead than the provider can hold money (providers commonly hold funds for at most 90 days, and card authorisations lapse within days): a deposit at booking and the balance inside the hold window, or an earlier payout to the host under published risk rules.

features.name: Damage deposits
features.does: Ask guests for a refundable deposit, held on their card or paid, and released after check-out unless you claim.

parts.name: Stay deposit rules
parts.what: Stay's rules on the kit's deposits and damage holds: the host sets an amount within a voted cap, held as a card hold or a paid deposit, and card holds on long stays are re-authorised before they lapse.

parts.name: Deposit release clock
parts.what: Counts the claim window from check-out and releases the deposit when it ends.

features.name: Host payouts
features.does: Choose how and when you are paid, and see each payout and what was taken out.

assess: Does every search result show the full price, with every fee, tax and levy, before a guest opens the listing?
Can a host join without leaving the other booking sites, with calendars synced, double bookings caught, and a fair rule when one still happens?
Is the core set small enough for a first release, and could a host and a guest complete a whole stay with only core features?

Does the map name every legal duty the platform carries in NZ: GST on listed services, flat-rate credits, opt-outs and listing intermediaries, income reporting to IRD, anti-money-laundering, council rules and campground registration?
Who holds the money at every step, does the rule for bookings made months ahead stay inside the provider's time limits, and does any part make the co-op hold funds itself?
Is the seller of record settled for bookings on Spare Stay, on hosts' own pages and through booking boxes?
Who pays for guest protection and goodwill when the host is not at fault, and is the cap published?
Is damage cover answered, including whether a co-op pool needs a Reserve Bank licence, or is it still the biggest open risk (piece ST03)?
While only hosts are members, are panels, review removals and fee votes fair to guests?
Do host votes and the pricing tools stay clear of cartel provisions under the Commerce Act?
Is the worker status of cleaners and co-hosts settled before any payout split pays them?
How will guests find Spare Stay when the big sites hold the demand, and is the reach plan more than hope?
Are accessibility features proven with photos, and does the app itself meet WCAG 2.2 AA?
Does every action go through the command API, so AI agents, plugins and scripts can do what a person can, and are agents kept from grabbing scarce dates or harvesting addresses?

Has every Stay part that copied a kit part become a thin use of it, and has the kit taken on the shared parts Stay marks to move down: people on an order, personal calendar feeds, smart lock links, floor plans, own booking sites, open listing feeds, search-friendly pages, saved and scheduled messages, the levy engine and cross-app add-ons?
Does the trip page still work at a bach with no signal, and are door codes safe once the stay ends?
Can a new country be added as a rule pack of data, without new code?
Does anything in the demo copy an incumbent's names, icons, wording or screen designs?
Which parts are large and core, and who could take them on first?
